note: NASA FIRMS: active-fire detections from the VIIRS instrument on Suomi NPP.
title: NASA FIRMS VIIRS active fires
description: One event per VIIRS (Suomi NPP) active-fire detection inside the configured areas (default Sudan and Ukraine, as in round 3), from the standard-processing archive and, after its last date, the near-real-time product. Low-confidence detections are left out by default, as round 3 did.

sources.title: FIRMS area API, VIIRS S-NPP 375 m
sources.publisher: NASA Fire Information for Resource Management System (LANCE)
sources.license: NASA data, free use with acknowledgement (MAP_KEY required)
sources.known_at_rule: Acquisition time plus 3 hours, the near-real-time latency (basis proxy_publication_lag).

event_types.title: A satellite detects an active fire in one pixel
